ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Product Didn't Arrive"), OR( ISBLANK(Customer_Description__c), ISBLANK(Date_Of_Expected_Delivery_Service__c), ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contacted_Merchant__c,''), ISBLANK(Merchant_Description__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Customer Description, Date of Expected Delivery/Service, Customer Contacted Merchant, Merchant Description.
